title: Custom Pages
description: Learn how to create custom pages for your store, including About Us, Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, and more.
content:
Custom Pages

Create custom pages for your store to provide additional information, legal pages, or any content you need beyond products and blog posts.

Creating a Custom Page

Step 1: Access Custom Pages

Navigate to Custom Pages in your dashboard and click "Create Page".

Step 2: Basic Information

Fill in page details:

  • Title: Page title
  • Slug: URL-friendly identifier (e.g., about-us, terms-conditions)
  • Description: Brief description for SEO

Step 3: Page Content

Add your page content using the editor:

  • Rich text editor
  • HTML editor
  • Media uploads
  • Formatting options

Step 4: SEO Settings

Configure SEO for the page:

  • Meta title
  • Meta description
  • Meta keywords
  • Canonical URL

Step 5: Publish

Set page status and publish:

  • Published (visible to all)
  • Draft (not visible)
  • Private (password protected)

Common Custom Pages

About Us

Tell your story, mission, and values.

Terms & Conditions

Legal terms for using your store.

Privacy Policy

How you collect and use customer data.

Shipping Policy

Information about shipping methods and costs.

Return Policy

Return and refund policies.

Contact Us

Contact information and form.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions.

Page Templates

Use page templates for consistency:

  • Default template
  • Full-width template
  • Sidebar template
  • Custom templates

Page Settings

Configure page settings:

  • Page visibility
  • Menu placement
  • Footer placement
  • Page order
  • Parent page (for nested pages)

Adding Pages to Menu

Add custom pages to navigation:

  • Header menu
  • Footer menu
  • Sidebar menu
  • Custom menu locations

Page Content Tips

  • Use clear headings
  • Break up text with images
  • Use bullet points for lists
  • Include call-to-action buttons
  • Optimize for SEO
  • Make it mobile-friendly

Managing Custom Pages

Manage your custom pages:

  • Edit page content
  • Update SEO settings
  • Change page status
  • Delete pages
  • Duplicate pages
  • Export/import pages

Best Practices

  • Keep content updated
  • Use clear, simple language
  • Include relevant images
  • Optimize for search engines
  • Make pages easy to find
  • Test on mobile devices
